verdict.rationale: The board acts as an AirPlay receiver that captures the mirrored screen. The agent needs an OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint, and each run records the screenshots alongside the taps and swipes drawn on top, so its actions are tied to the captured display. missing for 10: an explicit description of how the model maps screenshot content to tap coordinates (grounding mechanism), and independent or hands-on corroboration of perception accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the agent perceives the live screen (capture or vision input) and grounds its actions on what is actually displayed

citations.quote: The board is now the AirPlay receiver and the mouse, and the agent runs in an iPhone app on the same phone.
Any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint works (vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama, cloud APIs).
